environment: Windows 11 Pro build 26300; HeadlessChrome/156.0.0.0 per run JSON browser field
dart: 3.13.1 via Flutter 3.47.1, dart2js --release --no-web-resources-cdn, temporary entry spike/md-bench/main.dart calling real app.main()
rust: 1.98.0 stable from rust-toolchain.toml; wasm-bindgen crate and CLI 0.2.129; target wasm32-unknown-unknown; opt-level=z, codegen-units=1, lto=true; no nightly, no -Z build-std
uuidJsSpikeOnly: spike/md-wasm-p0/Cargo.toml enables uuid js feature solely so existing commands compile on wasm32 before S1 T1.4 replaces Uuid::new_v4() with Sequential ids. The official md-wasm crate must not keep this feature.
childrenIndexingSpikeOnly: spike/md-wasm-p0/src/lib.rs pre-indexes document block ids once before mapping root.children, avoiding a wrapper-induced quadratic lookup; S4 wire path should retain an equivalent indexed lookup before locking thresholds.

performance.method: full binding call parseBody(markdown) -> Rust JSON -> Dart jsonDecode -> mapped BlockSpec records, measured by adaptive batches inside one browser; alternating sample order; 15 batch samples; medians below
